title: Avuvram

paragraphs: [Chullin 38a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.38a.14): Ravina said, “Sama bar Chilkai told me: the father of bar Avuvram raised an objection to this.” [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Chullin.38a.14.2) explains that this is Avuvram himself: people knew the son but not the father, so they called the father by his son’s name. Some say instead, “the brother of bar Avuvram.”[^1]

notes.text: The linked Chullin gives the father or the brother as alternatives. Rashi explains how the son’s name served to identify the father. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=126&lang=en) gives the same gloss and says he did not find in the Arukh the description attributed to it by Yuchasin.
